title: Read-only Claude reviewer cannot run git: bash reports "git: command not found", PowerShell and full-path git.exe are denied
outcome: A read-only reviewer child of every vendor can inspect the staged, unstaged and untracked changes it is asked to review with git's read-only commands, on the running host build.
acceptance: A read-only reviewer child of each vendor TermAl can spawn as a reviewer runs `git status`, `git diff` and `git diff --cached` in its workdir; a test covers the child's command environment.
The cause is established from a reviewer child's own report of its shell, git and PATH on the running build, and recorded in a note.
The full five-stage gate passes on the exact reviewed tree, its run directory and fingerprint cited in a note.
When a reviewer cannot run git, its structured result says so and the parent's consolidation marks the review as incomplete, not clean; a test shows it.
